rejection_reason: PARK (updated 2026-10-23: the original blocker is now PARTIALLY resolved, and what replaced it is a decision, not a measurement). The 2026-10-21 record said no KNBS channel offered anonymous bulk/API access with stated licence terms; the new KNBS National Statistical Repository (repository.knbs.or.ke, DSpace 10.0) now DOES: anonymous REST API, 1,366 discover-indexed objects, and a blanket reuse statement on the repository's own pages. The remaining blockers: (1) the stated licence is CC BY-NC 4.0 - reuse 'for non-commercial purposes, with attribution'. Our public research releases are non-commercial and free, so an NC condition is arguably satisfiable, but NC is a restriction our releases would have to carry through to every consumer, and it must NOT be treated as an open-data grant (recorded per the licence-posture rule; operator decision required before any KE build). (2) Item-level content is not anonymously enumerable (401/404 on item endpoints; location queries return 0), so no series, format or release-census evidence exists yet - a channel is not a task. (3) Sector-regulator probes (CBK/KRA/NTSA) from the original next_action remain unprobed (CBK unreachable from the coordinator this tick).
next_action: Three steps, in order: (1) OPERATOR DECISION on the CC BY-NC 4.0 posture - is a non-commercial-conditioned source acceptable for our public releases (NC carried into LICENSE.md), or is NC disqualifying by policy? Record the decision here either way; do not probe further against it until decided. (2) If NC is acceptable: item-level census of repository.knbs.or.ke via the repository UI (browser-rendered search/browse) or an authenticated API path, looking for ongoing dated series at a useful grain (crime, market prices, transport, energy) with documented release dates - a channel is not a task until a series, its licence-on-the-item and its timing are all measured. (3) Regulator probes (CBK, KRA, NTSA) per the original 2026-10-21 next_action, for a task-shaped series with its own stated terms. If (1) is 'no', Kenya reverts to parked-indefinite with the NC decision as the blocker.
